CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) and a separate origin/representation entry for the same p0/current/n3 node are both present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries list identified colored cell sets (referent and attribute specified).

D.rationale: The report separately lists the node's content (red coordinate) and an origin/representation status for the same node/time.

O.rationale: The text states how coordinates map to rows/columns and provides origin/representation metadata describing presentation/access for nodes.
